items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: it was me, Jean Knight and Oliver Morgan, the three of us. Because we recognized what was going on and we used to talk about them. And you know. You cannot initiate it. I sure started on stage.

ctx.x: Yeah, you've made a lot of records over.

Now, you know, I was talking to Oliver Morgan. Oliver Morgan said, how many? And see, this is not all. See, because we don't talk, we're gonna get together and talk about this other album, the one that just came out with Imperial. Oh, okay. We talked about that one. We did? Okay. Yeah, we talked about those songs. Okay. Yeah, we talked about all that. But you see, Oliver asked me, he said, man, how many records have you recorded? I said, I couldn't give you a figure. I said, really? I don't know. I said, I know I…
Yeah, you mean you could sing more than that? Yeah, sing more than that. More than that, right.
